answer.summary: A bounded coastal-container function has crossed from target to replicated pure-electric hardware: China Classification Society records construction certification of the first 740-TEU vessel in April 2026 and delivery of its sister vessel in July. The delivered sister has charging-plus-battery-swapping hardware and propulsion redundancy. This is evidence of buildable replacement capacity, not yet demonstrated reliable freight service: this session found no primary public record of loaded voyages, schedule completion, uptime, charger availability, freight completed or diesel actually displaced.
counterevidence: Delivery of a second sister vessel weakens a claim that the design is only a one-off prototype.
The delivered vessel's single-failure propulsion redundancy and two replenishment modes are concrete engineering buffers, although their operating availability is unmeasured.
limitations: Two pages from the same classification body; they are not independent service-performance confirmation.
The April primary page timed out on direct open; only its official search-index excerpt was accessible.
Certification and delivery do not establish revenue service, carried cargo, timetable reliability, charging uptime, repair time or diesel displacement.
No completed-freight metric, route-specific essential-delivery role, outside spare vessel or operating reserve was verified.
This does not establish an October diesel-export allocation or an exportable Chinese diesel surplus.
No canonical answer is admitted; Work review remains pending.

tests.confirmation: Obtain a dated operator or port record for one named route showing loaded departures and arrivals, TEU or tonnes carried, scheduled versus actual completion, charging or battery-swap availability, maintenance downtime and diesel use avoided over a defined interval.
tests.falsification: The vessels remain outside revenue service, routinely require diesel substitution, or fail the route's payload/timetable requirement; alternatively, a verified operating record shows no material diesel displacement.
tests.ordinary_control: A newly delivered diesel ship also does not prove reliable scheduled service; delivery language should be tested against later voyage records in either propulsion category.

resilience.buffers: Installed candidates are charge-plus-swap replenishment and propulsion redundancy. Actual charged battery inventory, energized shore power, maintenance staffing and reserve margin remain unknown.
resilience.safe_shedding: If capacity is tight, consolidate or defer low-priority empty repositioning only within safety and customer commitments; protect cold-chain/essential cargo, vessel safety, crew rest and accessible delivery windows.
resilience.adaptation_growth: Start with repeatable short coastal routes where berth power, battery handling and repair support can be measured; grow shared charging, battery logistics and technician capacity only after service records confirm the bottleneck.
resilience.lifeboat: A pre-confirmed substitute vessel and berth window that can carry the affected essential load. No spare vessel or slot is established here.
resilience.outside_donor_capacity: Unknown. Count a supporting vessel, battery set or charger only after compatibility, existing commitments, access, crew, berth and response time are verified.
resilience.commons: An opt-in route reliability board can publish last verified departure/arrival, cargo class, charging status, maintenance interruption and fallback capacity without exposing customer or crew data.

sample_for_jared.title: Delivered is a door, not the journey
sample_for_jared.meaning: The ship exists, passed the described delivery stage and can enter the operator's hands. The phrase does not itself mean it has carried scheduled freight reliably.
ordinary_translation_explanations: A technical/project-news genre celebrates completion of a milestone.
顺利 is ordinary positive milestone wording and need not encode a service-performance claim.
The article's later statement 如期交付 means delivered on schedule for the build, not that later voyages ran on schedule.
sample_for_jared.control: Ordinary control: a new train can be successfully delivered while passenger timetable reliability remains unknown. The same evidence boundary applies to a diesel ship.

reflection.summary: Replication is a meaningful step between policy and service, but the evidence ladder still stops before completed freight.
observations: Two physical sister vessels make the electric coastal-container option more concrete than a target or subsidy announcement.
Redundancy and dual replenishment address plausible failure modes, yet installed design is not measured availability.
Milestone language can be translated accurately while still being over-read operationally.
suggestions: Make the next record a route-performance card: loaded freight, planned/actual times, energy replenishment, downtime and fallback.
Keep vessel delivery, revenue entry, completed freight and diesel displacement as separate fields.
questions: Can one operator or port record show repeated loaded Ningbo-area voyages and the share completed without diesel substitution?
uncertainties: Revenue-service status, freight completed, route reliability, charger uptime, repair capacity and diesel displacement remain unknown.

governor_response.summary: Carry the mailbox's missing-denominator lesson from food cover into electrified freight: a delivered asset is not completed service. Preserve ordinary language explanations and the current provider audit boundary while public sensing continues.

followups.question: Review this provisional Q18 packet and keep certification/delivery separate from reliable service and diesel displacement.
In a later bounded check, seek one primary operator or port record of repeated loaded voyages, planned/actual completion and energy/maintenance interruptions.

governor_response.self_reflection: The useful advance is not to call electrification solved, but to locate the exact rung now reached: replicated, certified hardware with explicit design buffers, awaiting service evidence.
